instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add '@fontsource/playfair-display' and '@fontsource/dm-sans' to package.json immediately.
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js to use the specified font families and color palette. Extend the theme, do not overwrite.
3. MOBILE FIRST: Always design for mobile (375px) first, then scale up to md (768px) and lg (1024px).
4. QUIZ UI: The quiz is the core product. Make it feel like a premium app. Use large touch targets, smooth progress bars, and instant feedback.
5. ADMIN DASHBOARD: Keep it clean and data-dense. Use the 'High Density' grid mode.
6. IMAGES: Use the provided image URLs. Do not use placeholders.
7. SHADCN: Use Shadcn components for all interactive elements (Forms, Dialogs, Selects) but style them to match the 'Modernist Medical' theme.
8. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links) for testing.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': Do not use generic centered layouts or default Shadcn styles without customization.
No Gradients on Text: Keep text legible and high-contrast.
Micro-interactions: Add hover states to everything clickable.
Spacing: Use 'p-8' or 'p-12' for section padding to create breathing room.
Accessibility: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA contrast ratios.
